feedback:
Approved for this race. The candidate is a single-variable test of sensor y placement. It keeps the iteration-3 wide span (x = ±0.07 m), kp 2.0, ki 0.4, kd 0.15, base_speed 1.1 and last_direction, and moves the sensor row from y = 0.05 m to y = 0.02 m. The evidence behind the move: iteration 3 (wide span) cut line_loss_events from 1 to 0 on every track, so line loss is no longer the main failure. Iteration 4 (base_speed 1.1) left max_error pinned at 0.0607 to 0.0629 across all tracks and only nudged progress, so speed is not the main driver. Across iterations 0 to 4, changes to kp, ki, kd, sensor_size and span have not moved max_error off roughly 0.061. Moving the array closer to the axle is the next untested geometry variable. Risk to watch: a shorter lead ahead of the axle gives the controller less time to react on bend entry, so max_error could rise even if the early transient is fixed. Judge the result by max_error and line_loss_events per track, then progress and completion_time, not by score alone.

What to change after the race, depending on what it shows:
- If max_error drops below 0.06 on s-bend and oval and progress rises clearly above the iteration-4 values, keep y = 0.02 and step base_speed up (1.25, then 1.4) while checking that max_error stays under 0.06.
- If max_error stays near 0.061 at y = 0.02, the geometry is not the cause. Test kd = 0.3 with everything else unchanged, since kd has never been raised above 0.15.
- If line_loss_events returns to 1 or more on slalom after the move, return the row toward y = 0.05 and keep the wide span, and test line_loss = search_right or search_left, which has never been tried.
requested_changes: Keep y = 0.02 m for all five sensors with x = -0.07, -0.035, 0, 0.035, 0.07 m. If max_error falls below 0.06 on s-bend and oval with progress above the iteration-4 values, step base_speed up to 1.25 and then 1.4 while checking max_error (iteration 4 showed base_speed 1.4 to 1.1 barely changed max_error, so speed is not the main lever).

If max_error stays near 0.061 at y = 0.02 (iterations 0 to 4 all pinned near 0.061 across gain, footprint, span and speed changes), set controller.kd = 0.3 with all other values unchanged, since kd has never been tested above 0.15.

If line_loss_events returns to 1 or more on slalom after the move, set geometry.sensor_positions y back to 0.05 and test controller.line_loss = search_right or search_left in place of last_direction, which no iteration has tested.
